description: This header file declares interfaces for the xdiff library, including functions for diffing files, reading files, comparing lines, hashing strings, and configuration management. It also defines related function pointer types and constants, with specific focus on handling large files and early termination of diff operations.

methods.name: xdiff_emit_line_fn
methods.description: Function pointer type for emitting diff lines, can signal early termination by returning 1.

methods.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
methods.description: Function pointer type for emitting diff hunks, includes parameters for old and new file line ranges and function name.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two memory-mapped files with configuration parameters.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Performs a diff between two memory-mapped files and outputs the diff using callback functions.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads a blob object into a memory-mapped file structure, identified by object ID.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Determines if a buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets the function to find diff hunks based on line content.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears the currently set line finding function.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a conflict style name from a string.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures merge styles based on variable name and value.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two lines of text with custom whitespace handling, returns 1 if equal.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Computes a hash of a string with whitespace handling flags.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
